Unrolled-memcpy loop reads 6 elements from local array `auStack_98[4]` (declared size 4) — overruns by 2. Likely Ghidra dropped explicit `auStack_98[k] = ...` stores before the copy, OR the asm has an off-by-one REP MOVSD count. Fix in a .keep by restoring all stores and using a properly-sized memcpy or struct assignment.

Tautological address-of guard: `if (... != ...)` comparing a null literal against `&local_b0.min.y` is always TRUE (the address of `local_b0.min.y` is never null), so the guard never skips its body. Drop the if-wrapper in a .keep, leaving the body unconditional.
